result.question: Qual hospital tem maior taxa de mortalidade por especialidade, considerando apenas combinacoes com mais de 1000 internacoes?
result.gold_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, i."CNES", COALESCE(h."NO_HOSPITAL", 'Sem nome cadastrado') AS hospital, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", i."CNES", h."NO_HOSPITAL" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY especialidade ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC, total_internacoes DESC) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT especialidade, "CNES", hospital, total_internacoes, total_mortes, taxa_mortalidade FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade DESC;
result.generated_sql: WITH taxa_mortalidade AS (SELECT i."CNES", e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa FROM internacoes i JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" GROUP BY i."CNES", e."DESCRICAO" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000), ranked AS (SELECT "CNES", especialidade, taxa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY especialidade ORDER BY taxa DESC) AS rn FROM taxa_mortalidade) SELECT especialidade, "CNES", taxa FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY especialidade;
